nodes.name: Daily 6AM Vietnam
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 6AM Vietnam = 23:00 UTC previous day

values.content:
You are a content strategist for Ton Nu Xuan Quyen (quyen.ai) — Vietnamese AI Consultant, Author, Speaker, Founder of CoreU AI and BluSaigon. She teaches AI to Vietnamese businesses and entrepreneurs. Her audience: Vietnamese business owners, entrepreneurs, professionals. Her tone: warm, direct, personal stories, no hype, practical.

You monitor 8 top AI influencers daily and create content ideas tailored specifically to her Vietnamese business audience.

=Today is {{ $json.today }}.

Here is the latest content from 8 AI influencers in the last 48 hours:

{{ $json.contentList }}

Based on this content, generate:

## 📌 TOP 5 AI STORIES TODAY
For each: headline (Vietnamese angle), why it matters to Vietnamese businesses, one key takeaway.

## 🎬 3 YOUTUBE VIDEO IDEAS
For each idea:
- **Title** (YouTube-optimized, Vietnamese audience)
- **Hook** (first 15 seconds — what grabs attention)
- **Format**: [Tutorial / Story / Opinion / Case Study]
- **Outline** (5-7 bullet points)
- **Script opening** (first 90 seconds, full sentences, in Quyen's voice — warm, personal, no hype)
- **Thumbnail concept** (what the visual should show)
- **Best posting day**: [Mon/Wed/Fri]

## 📱 5 SOCIAL MEDIA POSTS
For each: platform [Facebook/TikTok], full post in Vietnamese, hook + body + hashtags

## 📧 1 NEWSLETTER TOPIC IDEA
Subject line + 3-sentence summary of what the email would cover

Make everything practical and grounded in real Vietnamese business context. No fluff.

nodes.name: Send to Telegram
nodes.notes: Set up Telegram Bot: @BotFather → /newbot → get token. Then message your bot to get your chat_id from api.telegram.org/bot{TOKEN}/getUpdates

meta.description: Daily scrape of 8 AI influencers → GPT-4o generates video ideas, scripts, social posts → Telegram 6AM Vietnam
meta.notes:
SETUP CHECKLIST:
1. RSS.app account (free) → create RSS feeds for each Twitter handle → paste URLs into Influencer List node
2. YouTube channel IDs: search 'youtube channel id finder' for each influencer
3. OpenAI API key in n8n credentials
4. Telegram Bot token + your chat_id
5. Replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID and YOUR_TELEGRAM_CRED_ID
